g.text: Create a generic 2D placeholder UI kit for a Unity game, art
direction intentionally undefined. One 9-slice panel, one 9-slice
button in normal/hover/disabled, horizontal health and stamina bars
with fill and frame, and eight monochrome icons: settings,
inventory, map, sound, pause, close, arrow, confirm. Neutral greys
plus a single accent colour, 2px stroke, SVG source with PNG exports
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
